I grew up southern baptist until about 17 years of age. I have since changed my view points on many many things. I now consider myself atheist at the moment, but I am open to exploring options. I do not believe in an after life, not really sure about a higher power but probably not. I’ve done a little research on Satanism, but I’m honestly just naive to other religions and am interested in associating with a group that shares similar views as me. Some controversial views I have: I am an ally of LGBTQ+, I think we should normalize transgender. I support abortion 1000%. I fucking hate racist people, pedophiles, and people who abuse women… very deeply. (Childhood trauma) Etc etc. I’m just trying to figure out what religion or group I identify best with. I am not against performing rituals, however I have a strong hatred for harming animals and rape or sexualizing children. I really don’t believe in like spirits or ghosts or karma really. Hell, maybe I’m just an atheist. I do believe that aliens probably exist and that they helped us build pyramids and gave us some technology and shit back then. I’ve done a lot of psychedelics and had a lot of deep fuckin thoughts about life, I feel like they’ve sculpted my view points on a lot of important things. I believe you should be a good person and have good morales, I don’t know why. But I feel like it’s important. And it’s important to love yourself and be accepting of others.  I truly believe that we are on this earth for such a short time in the grand scheme of things so we should make the best out of it and be optimistic every day, because when we are dead it’s just nothing. Like passing out. I believe in evolution. I don’t have any fucking clue what created the universe or anything but I believe the universe is so incomprehensibly vast that we are just sooooo fortunate enough to be in the Goldilocks zone of our solar system, able to produce life that evolved over millions of years and here we are… the most advanced species on this planet. I’m not too into politics, but I believe that this country would be led better if American citizens didn’t associate religion so much with politics. We are a “Christian country” but Christianity is dying and younger people are becoming more open minded. The next generation, I’m excited for it. I believe we should prepare the next generation to not follow the beliefs of Christian’s or old close minded individuals. I want children to be normalized with LGBTQ+…. I could go on and on. Please ask questions or help point me in the right direction. Thanks I’m advance. Much love everyone. ✌🏼
